newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hysan sets HK$2.0 bln five-year FRN.
newsitem.headline: Hysan sets HK$2.0 bln five-year FRN.

text.p: Hysan Development Co's HK$2.0 billion five-year floating rate notes issue has been launched via its wholly owned subsidiary, said lead arranger JP Morgan Securities Asia.
The issue has been fully underwritten by JP Morgan.
The notes were issued at par to float at 56.5 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.

Lead arrangers are Fuji International Finance (HK), DKB Asia, Sakura Finance Asia, Sanwa International Finance, Tokyo-Mitsubishi International (HK), Societe Generale Asia, BNP and Credit Lyonnais. Two more banks are expected to join the lead arranger group.
Each lead arranger will underwrite HK$200 million.
There is a management fee of 32.5 basis points and an underwriting fee of five basis points for lead arrangers, giving an all-in return of 64 basis points.
The issuer is selectively inviting banks to join the deal.
Management fees are 32.5 basis points for co-arrangers committing HK$100-125 million and 27.5 basis points for senior managers committing HK$75 million to HK$100 million.
Replies are due February 21. The signing date is set for February 28.
JP Morgan noted that highly-rated Hysan is an infrequent issuer and that the FRN has rarity value. The response to the issue has been positive, the investment bank said.
Hysan is rated A-minus by Standard and Poor's Corp. --
